descriptions.text: Another exchange drained, is Lazarus going for a September hat-trick? Remitano's hot wallets were hit for $2.7M, yesterday. But quickly frozen USDT ensured profits were vastly reduced. Are we… learning?

A massive suspicious withdrawal occurred on cryptocurrency exchange Remitano, with $2.7 million worth of cryptocurrency being withdrawn. Some blockchain analysts believe the exchange may have been hacked. Tether has frozen an address allegedly used by an attacker that held $1.4 million worth of cryptocurrency.

Remitano disclosed a September 2023 security incident after unauthorized withdrawals drained about $2.7 million from exchange hot wallets on Ethereum and TRON. Available evidence points to compromised operational credentials or private keys rather than a smart contract flaw. Tether later froze part of the stolen USDT, although public reports disagree on the exact frozen amount. Public disclosures and transaction evidence indicate a hot wallet credential or private key compromise that enabled unauthorized withdrawals from Remitano-controlled wallets.
